integrity.computational_method: Complete finite enumeration, acyclic face-poset matching and exact integral Morse boundary reduction.
integrity.reproducibility: A standalone Python standard-library program recomputes the enumerations, Hasse acyclicity, matrices and unit cancellations.
integrity.review_limit: Self-review only; independent audit not performed.

scientific_limitations: Only the twelve-vertex ternary word-length-three digraph is classified; no general Kautz-graph family theorem is claimed.
Homotopy type is nonequivariant; no automorphism representation is asserted.
Original 1999 foundational text and 2020 thematically relevant thesis not established as fully read; unindexed equivalent calculations remain possible.
title: A mixed-dimensional sphere wedge for the ternary length-three Kautz directed-forest complex
